about: Ground height for Google mode (v2/google.js): centimetres of bare-earth ground above the ground at the v2 origin, int16 little-endian, row-major, rows run south (+z) from z0, columns east (+x) from x0, one value per cell centre. NOT Google data. Written by scripts/v2/bake_ground_dem.py.
source: StratMap Bexar & Travis Counties Lidar 2021, TxGIO, CC0-1.0
datum_notes: ground_ellipsoid_itrf_m = NAVD88 ground + GEOID18 N (NAD83(2011) ellipsoid height) + the NAD83(2011) -> ITRF2014 height change (NGS 2016 Helmert, epoch 2024.0). Google tiles are in WGS84 ~ ITRF; this is the height Google mode puts at y = 0 before its own ground check.
